purpose: Rust lifecycle fixture coverage manifest for Sandbox adapter parity gates.

fixture_groups.product_scope: Sandbox execution client configuration and conversion into OrderMatchingEngineConfig
covers: GTD, contingent, position-id, random-id, and reduce-only flags

fixture_groups.product_scope: Sandbox start, connect, disconnect, stop, and starting account-state lifecycle
covers: starting balances and generated account state

fixture_groups.product_scope: Market-data input events that drive simulated matching engines
Simulated order submission, order lists, cancel flows, and generated order events
covers: generated order events without exchange calls

fixture_groups.product_scope: Internal binary-option paper settlement lifecycle driven by InstrumentClose events
covers: resting order cancellation at resolution boundary

fixture_groups.product_scope: Internal account state and report boundaries for simulated execution
covers: query_account emits generated internal account state
query_order has no external venue response
order, fill, position, and mass-status reports are not fetched from a remote exchange

scoped_blockers.summary: Sandbox now has a compact lifecycle fixture manifest for release-gate traceability.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Closed by RADP-023 manifest coverage for config, connect lifecycle, market-data matching inputs, order lifecycle, binary option settlement, and internal report boundaries.

scoped_blockers.summary: Sandbox is simulated execution only, not a data provider or external venue adapter.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: evidence is executable Rust lifecycle coverage for simulated execution and explicitly does not require external venue REST or WebSocket payloads.

scoped_blockers.summary: Sandbox matching behavior depends on matching-engine config and market-data input precision.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: manifest evidence pins config flags, quote/trade/bar input behavior, precision mismatch drops, and matching-engine lazy creation.

scoped_blockers.summary: Sandbox reports are internal/cache-driven and not external venue-style reconciliation reports.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: query_account emits internal account state, while order/fill/position/mass-status reports remain internal behavior rather than remote exchange payloads.

scoped_blockers.summary: Optional Sandbox Python, PyO3, and extension-module surfaces remain present.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Deferred to the Rust-only removal gate because RADP-023 does not authorize deleting optional Python/PyO3 adapter surfaces.
